reason: I don't take supplements unless my doctor tells me to, and nothing here says why I'd need magnesium. Lab reports are nice, but they don't answer whether I need it at all.
objection: Most supplements are a waste for me unless a doctor recommends it, and two capsules every day for a month is a hassle I don't see a reason for.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me my magnesium is low and recommending this kind of magnesium.
